claims.text: Japan's Ministry of Finance statement (dated 3 August 2026) confirms: "Japan's Ministry of Finance purchased the Japanese yen in coordination with the U.S. Department of the Treasury" on 31 July 2026 (US Eastern Time), an action that "countered excessive volatility and disorderly movements in the Japanese yen in recent months" and was carried out pursuant to the U.S.-Japan Finance Ministers' Joint Statement issued in September 2025.

The same Ministry of Finance statement states Japan "will not hesitate to conduct further joint intervention" and that it plans to "utilize the Federal Reserve's Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) Repo Facility in the future," signaling the intervention capacity remains active going forward.

The Ministry of Finance's own Foreign Exchange Intervention Operations monthly release for the period 29 June 2026 through 29 July 2026 (published 31 July 2026) reports: "Total amount of foreign exchange intervention operations for the period from June 29, 2026 through July 29, 2026: ¥ 0" — confirming no yen-buying intervention had occurred in the month immediately preceding the 31 July action.

The Ministry of Finance's Foreign Exchange Intervention Operations monthly release for the period 30 July 2026 through 26 August 2026 (published 28 August 2026) states: total amount of foreign exchange intervention operations for the period, JPY 15,399.3 billion -- confirming sustained yen-buying intervention through the reporting month, without a public breakdown of individual operation dates or amounts.

The Ministry of Finance's public listing of Finance Minister statements shows no further statement on yen intervention or foreign-exchange operations dated in September 2026; the only item posted in that month is a 1 September 2026 statement by Finance Minister KATAYAMA Satsuki on the re-election of Mr. Kanda for a second term as ADB president, unrelated to currency intervention. No monthly Foreign Exchange Intervention Operations release newer than the 30 July-26 August 2026 period has been published as of this check.

description: Japan's Ministry of Finance and the US Treasury conducted an emergency joint yen-purchase intervention on 31 July 2026 after the yen weakened toward a roughly four-decade low, with sustained yen-buying continuing at least through late August. No further intervention action or foreign-exchange statement has been confirmed since, and the episode has eased toward routine market conditions by September.

impact.summary: No direct casualties; the impact is financial and macroeconomic. Japan's Ministry of Finance confirmed it purchased yen in coordination with the US Treasury on 31 July 2026 to counter excessive volatility and disorderly currency movements after the yen weakened toward levels not seen in roughly four decades. Its monthly foreign-exchange intervention data show zero yen spent in the reporting month immediately before the intervention (29 June-29 July 2026), confirming the 31 July action was an emergency departure from routine operations, while the following monthly release (30 July-26 August 2026, published 28 August) recorded JPY 15,399.3 billion in total intervention for that period. As of 11 September 2026, the Ministry has issued no further foreign-exchange statement and no newer monthly intervention report has been published beyond the 26 August period-end; its only September statement on file concerns an unrelated Asian Development Bank leadership matter, suggesting the emergency intervention phase has eased.

location.region: Nationwide; foreign-exchange market action centered on Tokyo, coordinated with US Treasury

event.scale: Joint Japan-US foreign-exchange intervention that stemmed a multi-decade low in the yen; no further intervention action confirmed since 26 August 2026

name: Yen Crisis — Joint Japan-US Currency Intervention

updates.text: No further Ministry of Finance statement on yen intervention, and no monthly foreign-exchange operations report newer than the 30 July-26 August 2026 period, have been published; the only September item on file is an unrelated Asian Development Bank leadership statement. Status moved from ongoing to contained.

MOF's next monthly release (30 July-26 August 2026, published 28 August) recorded JPY 15,399.3 billion in total FX intervention for the period -- confirming substantial further yen-buying beyond the initial 31 July action, versus zero in the prior reporting month.
